description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, adding {B}.
Bone Miser triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, causing you to return Ovalchase Daredevil to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
